//: CI checks torana-plugins and torana-edge out into _sources/ so the registry and owned-content checks can read them. That puts foreign source inside the Astro project, and `astro check` type-checks the whole project — torana-edge ships AssemblyScript fixtures whose builtins (usize, u32, changetype, __free) are not TypeScript, so the site build fails on code the site does not own. Exclude the checkout root; nothing under it is site source.
